title: NHTSA 正在考虑调查特斯拉机器人出租车在学校区域超速的说法
summary: A new defect petition accuses Tesla’s Robotaxis of speeding through active school zones, and NHTSA has opened a file to decide whether to investigate. The agency puts the affected fleet at about 1,000 vehicles, Model Y and Cybercab. It’s the third federal action aimed at Tesla’s driverless fleet in about five weeks, after an audit query and a Special Order over how the Cybercab was certified. more…（原题：NHTSA weighs probe into claims Tesla Robotaxis speed in school zones）
